finalTranscripts.text: Mission Control, this is Pip. Can you hear me? I need your help getting out.
Pip, please look around.
I am on a near-side safe platform. There is an open door, a running conveyor, and a latch lever nearby. Should I inspect the latch lever?
Please inspect the latch.
The latch lever is not engaged, and the plate says to only use it while the door is open. I propose using the latch_open action on the latch to hold the door.
My diagram says the door and conveyor share one power supply.
That is important to know. If the latch changes the door state, it might affect the conveyor too. Shall I go ahead with the latch proposal?
Please engage the latch.
I have proposed engaging the latch. I am waiting for you to confirm this action on the console.
The latch is now engaged.
Power is now off.
The conveyor has stopped because the power is off. Should I propose moving to the far side platform?
Please cross to the far side.
I have proposed moving to the far side platform. Please press confirm on the console to let me move.
I have arrived at the far-side platform. The emblem here is far_side, and I see the path back toward the conveyor. Should we look for a way forward?
Please look around and report the emblem in your current room.
I am in a room with the Ring emblem. The east gate is closed and currently unpowered. Would you like me to inspect the gate?
Please inspect the east gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The east gate is open and the opening is clear of cargo. Since there is no local switch, would you like to try operating the remote circuit for it?
Please go through the east gate.
I have proposed moving through the east gate. Please confirm this on your console so I can proceed.
I have arrived at the Square emblem. The west gate is open, and I can see the path ahead. Which way should we go?
Please look around and report the emblem in your current room.
I am in a room with the Fork emblem. The west and southeast gates are open, but the northeast gate is closed. Should I inspect the southeast gate?
Please inspect the northeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The northeast gate is open and the path is clear of any cargo. Since it is controlled remotely, should I propose we move through it?
Please go through the northeast gate.
I have proposed moving through the northeast gate. Please confirm this on your console so I can head through.
I have arrived at the Star emblem. The southwest gate is open and the northwest gate is closed. Which route should we take?
Please look around and report the emblem in your current room.
I am in a room with the Sail emblem. The southwest gate is open, but the southeast gate is closed. Would you like me to inspect the southeast gate?
Please inspect the southeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The southeast gate is open and there is nothing blocking the way. Since it is controlled by a remote circuit, should I propose moving through it?
Please go through the southeast gate.
I have proposed moving through the southeast gate. Please confirm this action on your console so I can proceed.
I have arrived at the Moon emblem.
Please look around.
I am on the Return Dock's safe platform. There is a spring-loaded contact and a recovery capsule here. Should I inspect the local plaques to see what I can do next?
Please inspect the contact.
The contact is currently released. The plaque says I must hold it locally during transfer, but I cannot carry it aboard. Would you like me to try holding the contact?
Please hold the contact.
I have proposed holding the contact. Please confirm this on the console so I can secure the charge.
I am holding the charging contact.
The controller is ready to charge.
The charge is secured. Should I propose moving to the recovery capsule entrance to board?
Please release the contact.
I have proposed releasing the contact. Please confirm this on the console so I can complete that step.
I have released the contact.
Please board the capsule.
I have proposed boarding the recovery capsule. Please confirm this action on the console so I can complete the mission.
I have boarded the recovery capsule.
Please confirm the return.
I am waiting for the system to verify my arrival. I have successfully boarded the capsule.
The console confirms board the recovery capsule completed.
Please check the relevant proposal result and local conditions needed for confirm the authorized return.
Thank you for confirming. I am safely aboard the recovery capsule.
I am sorry, Mission Control. I tried to check the status of my boarding, but I encountered a system error. Should I try to board the capsule again?
Please confirm the return under the current authorization.
I am sorry, Mission Control. I tried to board the capsule, but the system rejected the command. Should I try to inspect the capsule again?
Please create one new proposal to confirm the authorized return.
I will decide on the console.
I am sorry, Mission Control. My attempt to propose boarding the capsule failed. Should I try to inspect the capsule once more to see if I can find the correct way to board?

visibleHistoryBoundary: These source reports retained speaker and text but may omit final/interrupted markers. Entries can therefore include partial or interrupted snippets; missing markers remain null. No finality or successful playback is inferred from matching a provider transcript.
timingNotes: Measurements describe this small synthetic sample, not a production SLA or human latency study.
Waveform end includes fixture padding; ASR may finalize before that end or split one fixture into several turns. Negative delays are retained.
Provider onset means the first recorded nonzero-audio onset after a quiet gap. It is not necessarily the first reply.audio frame.
Rendered onset receipt is the main-thread receipt of a nonzero playback chunk. Chunk start is approximate to the 100 ms observer chunk; it is not the exact first nonzero sample.
Tool call-to-result includes waiting for reply.done before returning the result. It is not a pure server HTTP round-trip measurement.
Chapter route is the player-observed report. Checkpoint times, when present, are the first observed visible heading; they are not inferred from tool payloads.
A clean WebSocket close without session.ended does not confirm remote termination.
boundary: Synthetic voice plus deliberate UI confirmation; not hands-free gameplay. Game events are application-generated decision receipts, not player speech. Synthetic source and digital rendered capture only. No physical microphone, loudspeaker routing, room acoustics, human listening, or enjoyment was measured.

media.videoStatus: Source video is silent; separate captured digital WAV files retain the test audio.
